measurement.candidate_primary_metric: resume opens per eligible exposed session
candidate_secondary_metrics: project-detail opens per eligible exposed session
contact-intent clicks per eligible exposed session
measurement.note: Metrics are definitions for a future experiment, not collected data. Raw visits do not establish a winner; contact clicks are not messages sent.

activation_gates: Prepare matching full-portfolio facts, project order, resume and contact actions for both candidates
Review the completed designs with the owner; direction approval is not approval of unfinished pages
Verify public deployment and preserve the original site as a separately reachable fallback
Agree a real collector, privacy/retention policy and comparable exposure/goal instrumentation
Define stable assignment, owner/bot/QA exclusions, locale/device handling and an observation window
Start with a pre-agreed allocation; do not select or automatically favor a winner without sufficient evidence
